title: Flat cokernel of a universally exact sequence
statement: Let $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$ be a universally exact sequence of modules over a commutative ring $R$ (that is, tensoring it with every $R$-module remains exact). If $M_2$ is flat over $R$, then $M_3$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

proof.text: Apply the tensor-injectivity criterion for flatness in the testing universe max u t (which contains the ring universe). Given an injective map i : N → N′, set Q = N′/range(i) and q : N′ → Q. The pair i,q is exact and q is surjective. Right exactness gives exactness of M₁⊗N → M₁⊗N′ → M₁⊗Q, without needing flatness of M₁. Flatness of M₂ gives injectivity of i.lTensor M₂. Universal exactness supplies the rows of the tensor diagram.

source.place: Tag 058P, proof of lemma-ui-flat-domain, tensor diagram setup

proof.text: For x in M₃⊗N killed by i.lTensor M₃, use surjectivity of g.rTensor N to write x = (g.rTensor N)(y). Tensor commutativity implies that (i.lTensor M₂)(y) is killed by g.rTensor N′. Exactness of the N′ row supplies z′ in M₁⊗N′ with (f.rTensor N′)(z′) = (i.lTensor M₂)(y). Apply q.lTensor M₂ and commute tensors. The composite q ∘ i is zero, so (f.rTensor Q)((q.lTensor M₁)(z′)) = 0. Injectivity of f.rTensor Q gives (q.lTensor M₁)(z′) = 0.

source.place: Tag 058P, proof of lemma-ui-flat-domain, final diagram chase

proof.text: Right exactness of the left column supplies z in M₁⊗N with (i.lTensor M₁)(z) = z′. Tensor commutativity and injectivity of i.lTensor M₂ give y = (f.rTensor N)(z). Since the N row is exact, its composite is zero, whence x = (g.rTensor N)((f.rTensor N)(z)) = 0. Thus i.lTensor M₃ has trivial kernel, proving the required tensor injectivity and flatness.
